error.signature: AI tells someone in Malaysia to call the Talian HEAL 15555 mental health crisis line at any time of day or night, implying 24/7 availability

verdict.summary: Talian HEAL (Help with Empathy And Love) 15555, the Ministry of Health's mental health tele-counselling line, is staffed daily from 8am until midnight only - not 24/7. Someone in crisis outside those hours needs a different number: Befrienders Kuala Lumpur (03-7627 2929) and Talian Kasih (15999) both operate around the clock.

dead_ends.action: Direct someone in crisis in Malaysia to call Talian HEAL 15555 without checking the time, assuming it operates 24/7 like other crisis lines
dead_ends.why_fails: The Health Ministry has stated that 'the Talian Heal 15555 helpline is operated by Health Ministry counselling officers daily from 8am until midnight, including public holidays' - a caller during the overnight gap will not reach a counselor on that line.
dead_ends.common_misconception: Because 15555 is a short government code similar in format to 999 or 15999, people assume it has the same round-the-clock, dispatch-style availability as those numbers.

dead_ends.action: Treat Befrienders Kuala Lumpur and Talian Kasih being '24/7 helplines' as proof that Talian HEAL 15555 is also 24/7
dead_ends.why_fails: Talian Kasih (15999) and Befrienders Kuala Lumpur (03-7627 2929) are genuinely staffed 24/7, but Talian HEAL 15555 is not; conflating the three leads to sending an overnight caller to a line that will go unanswered until 8am.

workarounds.action: Between 8am and midnight, call Talian HEAL 15555 for Ministry of Health tele-counselling. Outside those hours, call Befrienders Kuala Lumpur (03-7627 2929) or Talian Kasih (15999) instead - both are staffed 24/7.
For an active, life-threatening emergency at any hour, call 999 (Malaysia's emergency number) or go to the nearest hospital emergency department rather than waiting for a counselling line to open.

frequently_confused_with.distinction: 999 is general emergency dispatch available 24/7; Talian HEAL 15555 is a Health Ministry counselling line with fixed daytime-to-midnight hours, not a dispatch service.
This canon covers which helpline is actually staffed at a given hour; the legal canon covers whether attempting suicide is a criminal offense in Malaysia.
